name: Screen-time reset
summary: Step down your screen time week by week, with swap activities for the apps that pull hardest.

onboarding.reaction: Thanks for checking. That's the baseline.
Good target. We'll step down gradually.

onboarding.prompt: What would you rather do instead?

phases.name: Notice
actions: Move hardest apps off the home screen

phases.name: Step down
benchmarks: Daily hours step down each week toward target

plan_blueprint.calendar: Swap activities on the chosen slots and a weekly check of screen-time numbers.

approach_variants.habit: Replace one scroll moment a day with a swap; streak.
approach_variants.reward: Owner-chosen reward each week the target is hit.
approach_variants.resource: First week sets up app limits, a charging spot and swap supplies.

guardrails: Every plan item can be edited, moved or removed, and you can add your own steps.
Product, app or recipe ideas are labeled as suggestions; any affiliate link is disclosed.
restart_rules: A high day doesn't reset anything; the weekly average counts. A high week repeats that week's target.

price_log.basis: Launch proposal per docs/MARKETPLACE.md; pending owner approval
